responsibility: Implements GCC’s terminal decoration policy for diagnostics. This file owns the named SGR style table used by the diagnostic and pretty-print layers, parses the GCC_COLORS environment variable to override per-diagnostic color capabilities, decides whether color should be enabled under never/always/auto rules, and separately determines whether terminal hyperlink URLs should be emitted and in which escape-sequence format based on GCC_URLS/TERM_URLS and terminal heuristics, producing the low-level start/stop sequences consumed by formatted diagnostic output.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the diagnostic-color pair: it contains the concrete color capability table, GCC_COLORS parsing, tty-based auto-color decisions, and GCC_URLS/TERM_URLS URL-format detection, whereas diagnostic-color.h only declares the color policy enum and public entry points.
